△ 注意 お買い上げのお客様へ 必ずお読みください。
●本商品の対象年齢は15才以上です。 対象年齢未満のお子様には絶対に与えないでください。
●電池(別売り)、 電池ぶた、 ねじなどの誤飲事故に注意してください。
●尖った部分や鋭い部分がありますので、取扱いや保管場所に注意してください。思わぬケガをする恐れがあります。
●回転部に指や髪の毛や衣服などをはさまれないように注意してください。
●耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、聴覚を損なう恐れがあります。
●本商品には電子部品を使用しております。 ペースメーカーをご使用の方は、本商品を身体に近づけないようご注意ください。
<電池を誤使用すると発熱・破裂・ 液漏れの恐れがあります。 下記に注意してください>
●二次電池(充電式電池) は、 絶対に使用しないでください。
●古い電池と新しい電池、いろいろな種類の電池をまぜて使わないでください。
●+一(プラスマイナス)を正しくセットしてください。
blocks.translation:
• Warning — To customers who purchased this product: Please read before use.
• The target age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give this product to children under the target age under any circumstances.
• Beware of accidental ingestion of batteries (sold separately), battery covers, screws, etc.
• There are pointed and sharp parts; be careful when handling and storing. There is a risk of unexpected injury.
• Take care that fingers, hair, or clothing do not become caught in rotating parts.
• Do not use near the ear. If used accidentally, there is a risk of hearing damage.
• This product contains electronic components. Persons using a pacemaker should avoid bringing this product close to their body.
• Improper use of batteries can cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries) under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries when using.
• Set the + and − (polarity) correctly.

blocks.text:
●遊んだ後は必ずスイッチを切り電池をはずしてください。 電池を入れたままにしておくと、 液漏れの恐れがあり危険です。
●ショートさせたり充電、分解、加熱、火の中に入れたりしないでください。
●万一、 電池から漏れた液が目に入ったときはすぐに大量の水で洗い、医師に相談してください。
blocks.translation:
• After playing, always turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or put into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into your eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a physician.
• If battery fluid gets on the skin or clothing, wash with water.

blocks.translation:
• This product is made with precision. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product consists of precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold.
• Discard plastic packing materials immediately after opening.
• This product has painted parts; when storing it, do not let it contact other items (resin products, furniture, sofas). Color transfer may occur.
• Do not pull or bend movable parts or mounting parts strongly in an unnatural direction.
• Some pronunciations may have different intonation or may be difficult to hear due to the nature of the product; please understand this.
• Cannot be used with two units simultaneously.
• May malfunction due to other infrared remotes such as those for televisions.
• May malfunction when placed near windows exposed to sunlight or directly under fluorescent lighting.
• If a malfunction occurs, turn the power off and on again.
• Do not place stickers or similar items over the receiver or transmitter; it will stop operating.
• If there is an obstacle between the receiver and transmitter, the infrared will not be detected and it will not operate.
• Do not install gears other than those that are compatible with this product. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
• Do not install the gears included with this product on anything other than the Don Blaster - MEMORIAL EDITION -. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
